entries.title: How to build a 2.5D motion studio with Opus 5.5 (Full Course)
entries.author: Dumble
entries.summary: A 9-part course on the 27M-view 2.5D shorts format: flat 2D characters in lit 3D Blender sets. House rules, story and shot-list prompts, Blender MCP set passes, cut-out rigs, word-timed captions, sound cues and the frame-by-frame review loop, plus a ready SKILL.md.

entries.summary: A free, open-source CapCut replacement: 13 repos covering grab, cut, transcribe, caption, voice, clean, grade and render.
